_context.session.title: Title of the dialog showing a coworker's virtual computer screen. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.session.description: Under the title of the dialog of a coworker's virtual computer: what the person does there, the coworker sees afterwards.
_context.session.takeoverDescription: Under the title when the coworker asked the person to act in its browser (sign in, solve a captcha). Done is the button that hands it back.
_context.screen.wentAway: The live view of the coworker's computer disconnected.
_context.notch.browser: Button opening a web browser on the coworker's computer.
_context.notch.done: Button: the person has finished in the coworker's browser and hands it back.
_context.screenCard.takeControl: Shown when hovering the coworker's screen: a click lets the person drive it.

session.title: {name}’s desktop
session.description: The screen this coworker works on. What you do here, it finds afterwards.
session.takeoverDescription: You are in your coworker’s browser. Press Done when it can carry on.
session.takeoverHoldsBrowser: Your coworker’s browser is already open for this request.
session.clipboardDenied: Your browser did not let Rerun read the clipboard.
session.disconnectedDescription: The connection to the machine closed. Nothing on it was lost.
